content.title: What to include in your request
content.subtitle: A complete request gives the team a clearer starting point for availability, route review, setup requirements, and event-fit recommendations.

topics.title: Event date and hours
topics.description: Share the event date, backup dates, setup window, operating hours, and teardown expectations.

topics.title: City, state, and venue
topics.description: Include the city, state, venue type, site access notes, and whether the event is private, public, or ticketed.

topics.title: Surface and access
topics.description: Describe the surface, approximate footprint, slope concerns, load-in path, power access, and nearby constraints.

topics.title: Guest count and flow
topics.description: Estimate attendance, participant volume, age range, and whether skating is the main attraction or one part of a larger event.

topics.title: Rink experience goals
topics.description: Tell us whether you want a holiday centerpiece, corporate activation, family attraction, public-space draw, or private-party feature.

topics.title: Support and add-ons
topics.description: Mention skates, skate aids, benches, attendants, lighting, music, signage, decor, branding, or additional event support needs.

content.title: Portable rink planning built around the event, not a one-size-fits-all package
content.description:
Ice Rink Rentals helps event planners, organizations, schools, municipalities, shopping centers, venues, corporate teams, and private hosts explore portable ice rink rental options for memorable seasonal and special-event experiences.

The company focuses on practical planning, guest experience, and clear event-fit recommendations. Each request is reviewed around the event location, available surface, guest count, venue access, timing, and support needs so the recommended rink setup can match the event as closely as possible.

items.question: What information is most important for a quote?
items.answer: Event date, city and state, venue type, indoor or outdoor setting, available space, guest count, surface notes, rental duration, and desired add-ons are the most helpful starting details.

items.question: Can I request pricing before every detail is final?
items.answer: Yes. Early details can begin the review process. The scope can be refined as the venue, timing, and support needs become clearer.

items.question: Can portable rinks be reviewed for indoor and outdoor events?
items.answer: Yes. Indoor and outdoor setups can both be reviewed, but surface, access, available space, weather exposure, and venue rules matter.

items.question: Do you review skates, barriers, skate aids, and staffing needs?
items.answer: Yes. Support items such as skates, rink barriers, skate aids, benches, attendants, lighting, music, signage, and operations needs can be included in the planning conversation.

items.question: Can Party Pros East Coast help with other event rentals?
items.answer: Party Pros East Coast may be a useful partner resource if your event also needs broader party rental equipment or event support beyond the rink itself.
